newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom to proceed with Chile expansion.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom to proceed with Chile expansion.

text.p: Rio Algom Ltd said on Monday it was proceeding with a 65 percent expansion of its wholly owned Cerro Colorado copper mine in northern Chile, to bring annual production to 220 million pounds of refined copper by 1999 from the current 130 million pounds.

It said the US$198 million expansion, excluding interest and working capital, would be completed by mid-1998. Reserves at the expanded production rate were enough for about 20 years of production, while the expansion should reduce the average cash cost of production at Cerro to US$0.48 a pound in 1996 dollars from US$0.53 a pound, Rio Algom said.
